caption: The drawing features a symmetrical composition with a central large, stylized tulip at the top, primarily colored in red with blue and gold accents. Below the tulip, two red birds with blue wings, tail feathers, and blue crests face each other, perched on decorative blue stems that curve outward from the center. At the base, there is a brown vase or urn with black handles, red and gold horizontal stripes near the bottom, and a blue vertical decorative element, from which blue and gold leaves and stems extend outward and upward to frame the birds and flowers. In the top left and right corners, there are two simple blue birds, each in flight, facing the center. Among the foliage, two smaller red, gold, and blue tulip-like flowers hang downward on either side of the vase. The composition uses a limited color palette of red, blue, gold, black, and brown on an off-white background. Text at the bottom reads "FROM LATE 18th CENTURY DECORATION ON PAPER" and includes additional information about folk art and the source of the design.
title: Plate 15: From the Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
